## Project: GP2_EUR_YOPD_metaGWAS

### Author: 
- IHL

### Version: 
- PLINK 2.0, version plink2_mac_arm64_20250609.zip. Downloaded 19.06.25

### Notebook Overview
- This script performs GWAS using the recessive model on the NGRC (Hamza et al) genetic data
- All YOPD individuals in the NGRC data have age at onset >=18 years and <40 years, and all controls have age at sample collection >=18 to <80.
- The clinical data is prepared by LP, and the genetic data is QCed and imputed by LP previously

### Changelog
- Analysis performed 06.10.25
```{bash}

#Analysis performed on 06.10.25. GWAS were performed for chr 1-22 (all in the same file).

PLINK2_PATH="/Users/Documents/PLINK_2/plink2_mac_arm64_20250609/plink2"

  $PLINK2_PATH \
    --bfile /Users/Documents/NGRC/NGRC_Hamza_YOPDGWAS \
    --glm sex recessive hide-covar cols=+a1freqcc,+a1countcc,+gcountcc   \
    --ci 0.95 \
    --snps-only \
    --covar /Users/Documents/NGRC/NGRC_Hamza_YOPDGWAS_PCs.eigenvec \
    --covar-name PC1,PC2,PC3,PC4,PC5 \
    --pfilter 1 \
    --maf 0.005 \
    --adjust gc \
    --covar-variance-standardize \
    --out /Users/Documents/NGRC/NGRC_results/RECESSIVE_GWAS_NGRC_5PCs

# Print the output message and directory
echo "Written to /Users/Documents/NGRC/NGRC_results/RECESSIVE_GWAS_NGRC_5PCs"

```
